requirements.quote: Build validators `outward-draft.ts` (DraftRequest, DraftEdit, ShareRecord, Audience, Language), tables `outward_draft`, `outward_draft_version`, `outward_share_log` with RLS and migration
AI task `outward_update` (packages/ai/src/tasks, mock fixtures EN/TA/KN, drafting tier)
ADR 0038 (no send path), core-domains entry, and registries (cross-tenant registry, db index test, RLS catalog)
Tests: compose, guard (30+ phrases per language set), diff, share, no-send static test, cross-tenant, sensitive-matter template-only, India-only AI, client_contact requirement.
Acceptance criteria of #69 marked [type:unit] and [type:api] that concern core and db.

deliverables.change: zod DraftRequest, DraftEdit, ShareRecord, Audience (client|senior_counsel|briefing_counsel), Language (en|ta|kn), Tone (formal|brief|warm), share channels (clipboard|whatsapp_link|mailto|download); export from packages/validators/src/index.ts; add outward-draft.test.ts
tenantTable() outward_draft, outward_draft_version, outward_share_log per #69 data contract (workspace_id, FORCE RLS, composite FKs like obligation-tracking.ts); export in schema/index.ts

CREATE TABLEs, RLS policies on app.workspace_id, plus regenerated drizzle snapshot/journal entry under packages/db/migrations/meta (pick a timestamp later than 20261025095244, or the next free one on the base)

TaskDef `outward_update` (tier 'drafting', providers bedrock+sarvam, zod narrative-blocks output, promptId outward_update.v1); add id to TASK_IDS in packages/ai/src/types.ts and TASKS in tasks/registry.ts; add EN/TA/KN fixtures under packages/ai/fixtures/mock/outward_update/<inputHash>.json (hashes via inputHash from packages/ai/src/hash.ts) and a task test

composeUpdate: reads confirmed hearing/order/obligation facts with provenance, unconfirmed => 'to be confirmed' flagged line, narrative via the AI gateway (task outward_update), template-only when matter.sensitive, audience client requires a client person, creates draft + system version, audits outward.prepared
structured fact blocks per audience and tone in English (templates/ta.ts and templates/kn.ts likewise)
Tamil fact blocks per audience and tone
Kannada fact blocks per audience and tone
guardOutward: reject/strip advice, commitments, fee terms, outcome predictions, citations/authorities, for en, ta and kn phrase sets
diffDraft word-level diff (Indic-safe tokenising) plus saveEdit creating outward_draft_version rows and audit outward.edited (keep in diff.ts or a sibling file under outward/)
recordShared and recordCopied: explicit member action only, writes outward_share_log with channel and final_version_id, sets draft status, audit outward.shared; no job/system path
public barrel plus internal context.ts (scope, can('draft.write'), matter access like obligations/context.ts)
add "./outward": "./src/outward/index.ts" export
declare outward.prepared, outward.edited, outward.shared (security:false)
add `outward` domain to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (workspaces, audit, matter-graph, obligations, ai gateway adapters as needed) and the domain list
add the outward row
ADR (Status/Date/Context/Decision/Consequences per adr:lint): L4 only, no transport, share = clipboard/user-initiated links/download, guard, sensitive template-only; update docs/adr/README.md index

register outward_draft, outward_draft_version, outward_share_log (DB_TABLES_TEST) and SERVICE_TESTS entries for the new outward exports (or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason for pure helpers such as guardOutward/diffDraft)
add the three tables to the root table list; also add them to packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts RLS catalog and TABLE_TESTS/two-tenant seeders
real cases for composeUpdate/saveEdit/recordShared/recordCopied: B on A is denied or sees nothing, A unchanged

tests compose.test.ts, guard.test.ts (30+ phrases per language set), diff.test.ts, share.test.ts, no-send.test.ts (static import/job/endpoint scan), cross-tenant.test.ts, sensitive template-only, India-only AI, client requirement, tone

preserve.what: Policy matrix and snapshot unchanged: use existing `draft.write` (packages/auth/src/policy/actions.ts:15, matrix.ts:33); do not add policy actions
No new job, schedule or worker registration: apps/worker/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts and schedules.test.ts stay unchanged (no auto-share job)
AI gateway behaviour (packages/ai/src/gateway.ts sensitive block, India-only residency, ai_call audit) and existing task ids/fixtures unchanged
Existing obligation, hearing and order tables and the obligations service (packages/core/src/obligations, packages/db/src/schema/docket.ts) are read only, never altered
Migration numbering stays contiguous: use the next free timestamp after the base's latest (packages/db/migrations)

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/validators exec vitest run src/outward-draft.test.ts src/index.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/ai exec vitest run src/tasks src/__tests__ src/index.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/outward src/domains.test.ts src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts src/audit
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/config exec vitest run test/core-domain-boundaries.test.ts test/eslint-boundaries.test.ts

decisions.choice: Reuse the existing `draft.write` policy action instead of a new `outward.*` action
decisions.justification: actions.ts:15 and matrix.ts:33 already gate drafting at junior; avoids a policy snapshot change

decisions.choice: Model the contract on packages/core/src/obligations (context.ts scope/can/record, tenantTable schema in obligation-tracking.ts)
decisions.justification: Same-shape domain merged in #725; its CI misses were registry items

decisions.choice: `outward.shared` is emitted as an audit event (events.ts) which the activity feed and #86 read, not a new event bus
decisions.justification: obligation.* events in audit/events.ts:325-336 are the existing pattern; no separate outward bus exists

decisions.choice: Minimal client contact reference is a `person` of kind `client` (db/schema/people.ts) because no client_contact table exists
decisions.justification: The issue allows a minimal contact reference until #82; people.ts:39-58 holds client contact data

decisions.choice: AI prompt lives in the task file (promptId outward_update.v1), not packages/ai/src/prompts/
decisions.justification: No prompts directory exists; tasks/summarise.ts uses promptId only

decisions.choice: Language default falls back to the request language then 'en' until #72/#82 supply M6/M2 data
decisions.justification: No preferred-language columns exist in db/schema; #72 and #82 are open

decisions.choice: The #69 criteria in scope are its [type:unit]/[type:api] ones for core and db (compose from confirmed facts with provenance; EN/TA/KN; guard 30+ phrases per language set; unconfirmed => 'to be confirmed'; versions + word diff; action log with lawyer-only shared; no-send static test; India-only AI and sensitive template-only; client requires contact; tone formal/brief/warm; cross-tenant; RLS on new tables; zod inputs). The [type:e2e] criteria and Storybook, i18n catalog, visual and axe ones belong to #736/#737 and are not requirements of this issue
decisions.justification: #735 body scopes itself to 'Part 1 of #69' backend and names siblings #736 (web) and #737 (e2e)
